rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when something keeps going without stopping.

example.english: The air conditioner makes continuous noise.
example.jyutping: bou6 laang5 hei3 bat1 ting4 gam3 cou4

rows.note: Use this for an unbroken line, run, or sequence with no intervening space or gap.

example.english: It rained for three continuous days, so I didn't even want to go out.
example.traditional: 連續三日落雨，搞到我都唔想出街。
example.jyutping: lin4 zuk6 saam1 jat6 lok6 jyu5 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 dou1 m4 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1
